description: Synthetic toll account history for Dani Reyes (Crossway Toll Authority, a fictional state authority), generated for reproducible checks; not a benchmark task. Plazas, rates, plates, people, cards and notices are fictional. No real E-ZPass or Tolls by Mail data, rates or assets are used.

sources.description: scripts/generate-seed.cjs opens the account on 2025-01-06 and replays about 22 months of tolls, top-ups, auto-replenishments, notices, payments, disputes and statements through Crossway's own handlers, ending at the fixture clock (2026-11-02). Random transponder tolls and plate reads come from a fixed-seed PRNG; the current notices and vehicles are scripted. Workflow rules follow the public E-ZPass NY and Tolls by Mail sites; amounts and deadlines are Crossway's own.

transformations: Authority time is US Eastern (America/New_York rules computed in src/clock.cjs); amounts in cents; IDs stable across resets.
Outgoing Mail notices and spent previews from the generated history are cleared: history counts as delivered.

review.notes: Automated checks (validateSeed, ledger reconciliation, generator reproduction, date floor) do not replace human review of realism and variation.
